title: Magical Walnut
summary: Consolation prize container holding five Walnuts.

fields.Use: Open it to take five Walnuts. Each Walnut contributes 2 Camp Supplies.
fields.Acquisition: One possible prize from Akabi’s Wheel of Fortune at the Circus of the Last Days when you do not win the jackpot.
fields.Base value: 11 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
